previous.changeLog:
# Weekly Playlist (new)

A new automatic playlist that displays vehicles matching the current 3-week missions — filtered according to their vehicle restrictions (sub-role, class, nation, level). Sorted by priority within the list: first vehicles with missing Field Mods, then vehicles close to a Gunmark, then the rest. Is automatically rebuilt when you reroll a mission.

MOD_DYNPL_T11GRIND

# XP grind for TXI — Tech tree Tier X vehicles whose Tier XI successor is not yet in your garage and haven't reached the 326,000 XP threshold yet. Sorted by XP already farmed - closest to the goal first. Vehicles without a known T11 line are included too, as WG will eventually add one.  Updates automatically when you purchase a T11.
